mcqs.question: Solve the inequality: 3x - 5 > 7. Which of the following is the correct solution?
mcqs.explanation: Adding 5 to both sides gives 3x > 12. Dividing by 3 (positive) retains the direction: x > 4. Options B, C, and D do not satisfy the original inequality.

mcqs.learning_point: Represent solutions on a number line
mcqs.question: Which diagram correctly represents the solution set of the inequality x \le -2 on a number line?

options.A: Open circle at -2 with an arrow pointing left
options.B: Closed circle at -2 with an arrow pointing left
options.C: Closed circle at -2 with an arrow pointing right
options.D: Open circle at -2 with an arrow pointing right

mcqs.answer: Closed circle at -2 with an arrow pointing left
mcqs.explanation: The inequality includes -2 (\le), so the point -2 is filled (closed circle) and all numbers less than -2 are included, shown by an arrow to the left. Options A, C, and D either exclude -2 or point in the wrong direction.

mcqs.question: Which interval notation correctly represents the solution set \(x > 1 \text{ and } x \le 5\)?
mcqs.explanation: x > 1 excludes 1, so the left endpoint is an open parenthesis. x \le 5 includes 5, so the right endpoint is a closed bracket. Hence the correct notation is (1, 5]. The other options either include 1 or exclude 5 incorrectly.

mcqs.question: Solve the compound inequality: 2 < 3x + 1 \le 8. Which of the following expresses the solution set correctly?
mcqs.explanation: First part: 2 < 3x + 1 \Rightarrow 1 < 3x \Rightarrow x > 1/3. Second part: 3x + 1 \le 8 \Rightarrow 3x \le 7 \Rightarrow x \le 7/3. Combining gives 1/3 < x \le 7/3. Options B, C, and D either change the inequality signs incorrectly.

mcqs.question: The inequality 4 - 2y \ge 0 has the solution set:
mcqs.explanation: Rewrite: 4 - 2y \ge 0 \Rightarrow -2y \ge -4. Dividing by -2 (negative) reverses the inequality: y \le 2. Hence option A is correct; the other options misinterpret the direction of the inequality.

mcqs.question: A shop sells pens at \(x\) rupees each. If buying more than 5 pens costs less than \(\text{Rs }50\), which inequality correctly describes the possible values of \(x\)?
mcqs.explanation: Total cost for more than 5 pens: 5x < 50 (since the cost must be less than 50). Dividing by 5 gives x < 10. Options B, C, and D either reverse the inequality or include equality, which is not allowed by the problem statement.

mcqs.learning_point: Represent solutions on a number line
mcqs.question: Which of the following representations is **incorrect** for the solution set \(x \ge -3\)?

options.A: Closed circle at -3 with an arrow pointing right
options.B: Open circle at -3 with an arrow pointing right
options.C: Closed circle at -3 with an arrow pointing left
options.D: Closed circle at -3 with arrows pointing both directions

mcqs.answer: Open circle at -3 with an arrow pointing right
mcqs.explanation: The inequality includes -3 (\ge), so the point must be shown with a closed (filled) circle. An open circle incorrectly excludes -3, making option B wrong. Option A correctly includes -3, while C and D misrepresent the direction of the inequality.

mcqs.question: The solution set of the inequality \(|x - 2| < 4\) is:
mcqs.explanation: |x - 2| < 4 translates to -4 < x - 2 < 4, which gives -2 < x < 6. Both endpoints are excluded, so the interval is (-2, 6). Options B, C, and D incorrectly include one or both endpoints.
